entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return these garbage cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you, and I'm sorry for the wait. Can I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is VF88612. And don't give me a runaround. These things are junk. I got terrible blisters on my last ride.

Thank you for that information, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now. I'm sorry to hear the shoes caused you blisters. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference and fit issue?

It's everything! The cleats keep coming loose no matter how much I tighten them, and the fit is awful. I've bought shoes from VeloFit before, and this is the worst quality I've ever seen. I want a refund, and I want it now. If not, I want your manager.

I understand your frustration, and I assure you, there's no need for a manager. I can handle this directly. I see here that you received the shoes 78 days ago. Let me just quickly confirm our return policy for you.
78 days, 80 days, I don't care! They're defective. If you don't process this, I'll be posting reviews on every cycling forum on the internet about this.

I understand. And yes, I've just confirmed here. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you, no problem at all.
Oh. Really? So you'll take them back for a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file for you right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay. Well, that's what I expected in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
